name: Sera
source:
"If a cute girl is running by, is it wrong for a man to chase her?"	
The main hero of this story.
A good natured youth who runs a general store called "ZACCA" located in Kingdom Souk.
He acts nice to everyone no matter their status, a very 'princely' character.
But a few years back he was a rather rash kid, and he sometimes slips back into talking like a rough 'Yankee'.

[spoiler]His real name is Ortana Genua Asran.[/spoiler]
